applicability: The registered worktree-start preview and refusal comparisons in the confined preview test fixture, including its already-existing ambient lifecycle event case.
conditions: The fixture observes complete product paths and both repositories, keeps the transcript root inside coordination and pre-creates the empty workspace river lockfile.
The call-day interval comes from UTC capture days, with both ends inclusive; created record paths have their required kinds.
Earlier daily-log/river bytes remain a prefix; new rows and tool counts match the observed calls, and every new detail is named by a new line.
Only admitted direct-child entry creation explains a kept record directory mtime change; non-record paths and repository refs/worktrees/index remain unchanged.

exclusions: Production retention/compaction, budget-dropping or unwritable telemetry, which retain the existing product owners and are not exercised by this fresh-fixture equality proof.
Actual apply, arbitrary tool mutation and a third type of product write: the comparison supplies no implementation authority and an unexpected path remains a finding.
